camera.height: eye level, occasionally low among grass

lens.dof: everything painted equally sharp, with depth carried by layered backgrounds

lighting.practicals: light is painted as soft gradients rather than cast shadows

composition.movement_of_subject: characters run, climb and lean with full-body weight

sound.ambience_bias: wind through grass, birdsong, distant water, rustling cloth

music.instrumentation: A solo piano melody joined by warm strings
music.dynamics: swelling gently as the landscape opens, then thinning back to piano

must_include: wind visibly moves grass, cloth and hair

notes: Hand-drawn 2D with painted backgrounds and generous skies. Wind and weight carry the animation; there are quiet beats with no action at all.
